events.title: 스웨덴 헬싱보리에서 태어나다
events.description: 스웨덴 헬싱보리에서 태어났다. 학교 수업을 싫어해 고등학교 마지막 해는 독학으로 마쳤다.
events.description_en: He was born in Helsingborg, Sweden. He disliked formal schooling and completed his final year of high school by teaching himself at home.

events.title: 예테보리대학교를 졸업하다
events.title_en: He graduated from the University of Gothenburg
events.description_en: He earned his bachelor's degree from the University of Gothenburg.

events.title: 철학·물리학과 계산신경과학을 함께 공부하다
events.title_en: He studied philosophy, physics, and computational neuroscience
events.description: 스톡홀름대학교에서 철학과 물리학 석사를, 런던 킹스칼리지에서 계산신경과학 석사를 받았다.
events.description_en: He earned a master's degree in philosophy and physics from Stockholm University and a further master's in computational neuroscience from King's College London.

events.title: 런던정경대에서 철학 박사학위를 받다
events.title_en: He earned his philosophy doctorate at the London School of Economics
events.description_en: He completed his doctorate in philosophy at the London School of Economics.

events.title: 예일대에서 가르치다
events.description_en: He held a teaching position at Yale University for two years.

events.title: 시뮬레이션 논증을 발표하다
events.description: 우리가 컴퓨터 시뮬레이션 속에 살고 있을 가능성을 다룬 논문을 발표했다. 문명이 조상을 재현한 시뮬레이션을 대규모로 돌릴 수 있다면, 우리가 그 시뮬레이션 안에 있을 확률이 오히려 더 높다는 논증이었다.
events.description_en: He published a paper arguing that we may be living inside a computer simulation. He reasoned that if advanced civilizations run many ancestor simulations, the odds favor our being inside one of them rather than in original reality.

events.title: 옥스퍼드에 인류미래연구소를 세우다
events.title_en: He founded the Future of Humanity Institute at Oxford
events.description: 옥스퍼드대학교에 인류미래연구소를 세우고 초대 소장을 맡았다. 인공지능을 비롯한 인류의 실존적 위험을 연구하는 거점이 됐다.
events.description_en: He founded the Future of Humanity Institute at the University of Oxford and became its first director. It became a hub for studying existential risks to humanity, including those from artificial intelligence.

events.title: 슈퍼인텔리전스를 펴내다
events.description: 초지능이 인류에 가져올 경로와 위험, 대응 전략을 다룬 슈퍼인텔리전스를 펴냈다. 뉴욕타임스 베스트셀러에 올랐고 슈퍼인텔리전스라는 용어를 널리 알렸다.
events.description_en: He published Superintelligence: Paths, Dangers, Strategies, examining how superintelligent AI might arise, the dangers it could pose, and how humanity might respond. It became a New York Times bestseller and popularized the term itself.

events.title: 인류미래연구소가 문을 닫다
events.title_en: The Future of Humanity Institute closed
events.description: 거의 이십 년간 이끌어 온 인류미래연구소가 문을 닫았다.
events.description_en: The Future of Humanity Institute, which he had directed for almost two decades, closed its doors.
